column1: # Campaign 25 test evidence for the multi-relation SQL-node foundation.

column8: note
The bounded executable entry contract is covered through canonical argv parsing and fail-closed validation; the complete source file's global initialization and integration behavior remain open.
The Rust test target owns deterministic isolated startup inputs; Go TestMain environment orchestration remains open.
source_tikv_startup_surface_is_explicit_and_bounded covers accepted executable inputs and defaults; full TiDB component startup remains open.
Fallible process shutdown preserves run and authority errors and ordered cleanup; exact platform signal exit-code mapping remains open.
Scripted success and failure paths cover bounded process-owner teardown; generated Go signal cases and OS-specific codes remain open.
Unknown startup options fail closed; keyspace activation configuration is outside this bounded node and remains open.
Only immutable inputs consumed by this node are admitted; TiDB global-variable initialization remains open.
The node has one explicit deployable real-TiKV mode; TiDB deployment-mode inference and telemetry remain open.
The production authority requires validated PD identity before listener readiness; Kubernetes starter and manager-client behavior remain open.
Unsupported version configuration is rejected as unknown; NextGen version rewriting remains open.
Malformed and unsupported bounded startup values fail before side effects; NextGen release-version syntax remains open.
Legacy parallel configuration paths are rejected instead of normalized; NextGen placeholder compatibility remains open.
Readiness publishes stable cluster and authority identities for the configured process; keyspace observability labels and starter integration remain open.
Only TiKV is admitted and non-TiKV stores fail before startup; source observability branching remains open.
Focused tests cover the immutable subset consumed by the Rust node; the full TiDB configuration suite remains open.
unsupported_or_ambiguous_startup_options_fail_closed rejects unknown and removed options; TiDB's complete removed-variable catalog remains open.
Canonical host, port, PD, auth, connection, packet, and ordered table-list parsing is covered; TOML round trips and all unrelated settings remain open.
Positive numeric limits consumed by the SQL node reject zero and malformed values; transaction size configuration is not implemented.
Bounded catalog cardinalities are checked before allocation; TiDB index-limit configuration remains open.
Atomic descriptors reject zero and counts above TiDB's 4096 maximum before allocation; dynamic table-column-limit configuration remains open.
The plaintext native-password listener is constrained to loopback; configurable TCP no-delay behavior remains open.
The bounded executable covers only its real TiKV store admission; the complete store test surface remains open.
Case-insensitive tikv is accepted and mocktikv is rejected before startup; other TiDB store kinds and labels remain open.
Malformed framing releases the connection lease exactly once; the historical Go protocol edge and all packet variants remain open.
Concurrent stock-client tests exercise the initial native-password handshake; TLS and broader capability negotiation remain open.
The immutable connection timeout is parsed and applied to handshake, command, and writes; session-variable mutation remains open.
Blocked query cancellation and bounded connection drain are covered; Go statement timeout semantics remain open.
Concurrent listener shutdown cancels blocked work and releases connections through one lifecycle; the full Go shutdown surface remains open.
Factory drop precedes process-authority shutdown and final success; Go transaction commit wait groups remain open.
mysql_native_password authentication is exercised with exact account identity; plugin switching and other authentication plugins remain open.
Authenticated session identity is immutable after admission; COM_CHANGE_USER remains unsupported and open.
Native-password success and failure are covered; caching_sha2 and extension authentication remain open.
QUIT, EOF, malformed input, and shutdown paths release owned connections; all Go session close side effects remain open.
Process-local accepted, active, completed, failed, and maximum-active counters are covered; Prometheus labels and global TiDB metrics remain open.
Authenticated stock clients carry bounded connection attributes through handshake framing; TiDB's complete attribute exposure remains open.
Listener health follows owned startup and shutdown state; HTTP status endpoints and domain health remain open.
One ConcurrentSqlNode owns one listener and rejects setup failures without leaking leases; TiDB listener reinitialization remains open.
The shared shutdown handle is idempotent and process teardown remains fallible; the complete Go shutdown flag matrix remains open.
Connection admission stops before workers drain and backend authority shuts down; TiDB starter callbacks and status service remain open.
Ordered connection, region-cache, TiKV transport, and PD shutdown with combined errors is covered; general TiDB graceful shutdown remains open.
Framing and early startup failures release process-local connection leases exactly once; domain and session-pool leak checks remain open.
Concurrent authenticated clients prove bounded active and accepted connection counts; cluster-wide status variables remain open.
Configured accounts share deterministic fixed-worker admission and connection accounting; per-user dynamic limits and resource groups remain open.
